Subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II report + bridge letter and audit window

Hi Logan,

We're preparing our vendor assurance package for an upcoming procurement review and want to include Redwood's SOC 2 Type II materials. Can you confirm whether you can share the most recent Type II report (redacted as needed) and a bridge letter if the report coverage doesn't fully overlap our audit window?

Specific asks:
- SOC 2 Type II report (PDF) or confirmation of availability and access method (presigned link / secure transfer).
- Bridge letter confirming coverage or describing gap and mitigation if the audit window requested (see below) doesn't match the report period.
- A minimal evidence manifest (control snapshots, policy excerpts, log samples) that we can include for our security review.

Our preferred audit window: Oct 1, 2025 — Sep 30, 2026 (we'll accept +/- 30 days if needed)
Deadline for our package: Sep 17, 2026.

I've attached a short questionnaire for the procurement team to fill if that helps (attached).

Thanks — appreciate a quick confirmation and an estimated ETA for the materials.

—Alex
Alex Morgan

Acme Corporation

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report + bridge letter and audit window

Hi Alex — thanks for the note and the questionnaire. We're able to provide a compact package that meets procurement needs; below is an outline, delivery options, and a few one-line reply templates you can paste into your system.

Quick answers up front:
- Report availability: We have a SOC 2 Type II report covering 2025-01-01 — 2025-12-31 (Type II) on file. If you need coverage through Sep 30, 2026 we can provide a bridge letter that documents post-report compensating controls and recent changes.
- Delivery: We can share the report and bridge letter via a presigned S3 link (preferred), or secure upload to your SFTP/SharePoint. We can also arrange an NDA-protected DocuSign workflow if legal requires it.
- Minimal evidence manifest: attached (CSV) with suggested artifacts and small representative samples (policy excerpts, example log snippet, retention statements). Full telemetry is available on request; for procurement decks we recommend the compact set below.

Compact evidence playbook (what we usually share for initial reviews):
1) SOC 2 Type II report (PDF, redacted as requested).
2) Bridge letter (PDF) describing audit period gap and controls in effect since the last report.
3) Control snapshot: network/perimeter config summary (1–2 pages).
4) Identity & access policy excerpt + example IAM role audit (redacted).
5) Log sample (7-day sample, redacted) and retention policy excerpt.
6) Data handling and encryption brief (keys in KMS/HSM summary).
7) Contact & delegation matrix for follow-ups (who to contact for deeper evidence).

Delivery options (pick one):
A) Presigned S3 bundle (valid 7 days) — fastest. Link will be emailed.
B) Secure SFTP exchange — we provide credentials; you upload the questionnaire and we drop the package there.
C) Shared secure Drive link (access-managed) — good if you prefer Drive/SharePoint.

Proposed timeline:
- Confirm audit window & preferred delivery option by end of day Sep 3 -> we stage materials Sep 4–8 -> deliver by Sep 9 (gives you 8 days before your Sep 17 deadline). If you need faster turnaround we can compress.

Attachments enclosed for your convenience: "Redwood-SOC2-TypeII-BridgeLetter-Draft.pdf" (draft bridge letter you can include in your package) and "Redwood-Minimal-Evidence-List.csv" (manifest).

Copy-paste reply templates for your procurement system (pick one):
- Template A (standard): "Redwood provided SOC 2 Type II report and bridge letter; package delivered via presigned link on 2026-09-09. Contact logan_wright@redwood.com for evidence follow-up."
- Template B (needs more evidence): "Redwood provided report and compact evidence; request additional telemetry samples (7-day) via SFTP. Contact person: grace_oconnor@redwood.com."
- Template C (legal redaction required): "Redwood will provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II report and signed bridge letter; legal contact: ben_carter@redwood.com."

Let me know which delivery option you prefer and whether the Oct 1, 2025 — Sep 30, 2026 window works (or if you need strict coverage only within those exact dates).

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Director, Security & Compliance Partnerships
Redwood Inference
Attachment stubs: Redwood-SOC2-TypeII-BridgeLetter-Draft.pdf (pdf, 48KB); Redwood-Minimal-Evidence-List.csv (csv, 6KB)

Alex — quick clarifying note from the evidence side: if your reviewers want telemetry, we typically provide a 7-day redacted log sample (CPU/utilization and access logs) plus the retention policy excerpt.

Redaction options we recommend: redact account IDs, anonymize IPs, truncate user identifiers. If you need longer samples (30-day) let us know and we'll schedule the secure transfer.

Ben is copied for legal/redaction questions.

—Grace
Grace O'Connor
Security Controls Lead, Redwood Inference
